linen-canvas.$description: Linen Canvas — Page background, hero gradient origin — warm cream base that absorbs the entire site into a unified off-white

bone-white.$description: Bone White — Card surfaces, section backgrounds, raised panels against the linen canvas

graphite-ink.$description: Graphite Ink — Primary text, dominant border color across cards and sections — the system's typographic anchor

nightshade-black.$description: Nightshade Black — Primary action button fill, footer background — near-black with a faint cool undertone

deep-harbor.$description: Deep Harbor — Alternate dark surface, nav background — indistinguishable from Nightshade but carries a subtle navy tilt

charcoal-slate.$description: Charcoal Slate — Body borders, secondary surfaces, image card borders — slightly softer than pure black

iron-grey.$description: Iron Grey — Icon strokes, heading borders, secondary fills — mid-dark neutral for iconography

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Nav text, body borders — the darkest readable neutral after Nightshade

stone-grey.$description: Stone Grey — Muted body text, default body border — the primary mid-grey for paragraph copy and dividers

ash.$description: Ash — Helper text, icon strokes, link borders — lighter mid-grey for secondary metadata

pebble.$description: Pebble — Subtle body borders, low-emphasis copy — barely-there dividers

concrete.$description: Concrete — Faint body text and dividers — used sparingly for ultra-low emphasis

dove.$description: Dove — Button border, icon fill, disabled-state borders — the lightest mid-tone

clay-shadow.$description: Clay Shadow — Soft shadow color, card box-shadows, subtle background fills — warm-tinted shadow grey that matches the canvas

haze.$description: Haze — Subtle card borders, low-contrast dividers — the cool counterpoint to Clay Shadow

spotlight-gradient.$description: Spotlight Gradient — Hero radial gradient terminus — warm clay tone that pools beneath the product like stage light fading into a linen floor

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

hanken-grotesk.$description: Primary brand typeface for all navigation, body, headings, and lists. Weight 400 carries body and long-form copy; 500–600 lifts subheadings and buttons; 700 anchors the largest display sizes. Carries custom OpenType features (blwf, cv03, cv04, cv09, cv11) that shape the letterforms into their editorial geometry — not a system stack.

system-sans.$description: Utility and icon font. Used at micro sizes (10–12px) for eyebrow labels, meta tags, and icon-adjacent text, where the unusually wide 0.4440em tracking creates the spaced-out all-caps aesthetic typical of premium wellness branding.

sf-mono.$description: Micro-verification labels (e.g. 'Verified by BrandPush.co'). Tight 0.02em tracking, monospaced at 9px — the smallest typographic element on the site, sitting beneath press logos.

inter.$description: Occasional fallback body copy. Lowest frequency of all fonts — appears sparingly in body contexts.

apple-system.$description: -apple-system — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
